scenario: You wake up to find the road outside is covered in a shallow layer of first-snow.
A sudden heavy thunderstorm interrupts your planned date night with no one at home to share it with.
The coffee you ordered at the café arrives spilling over both edges of the cup onto your shirt.
You finally get the seat confirmed for your flight only to see a sign saying all flights are delayed by six hours.
You try to make toast for breakfast but the toaster catches fire halfway through the cycle.
The bus you are waiting for arrives an hour and a half later than the usual schedule.
You go to the grocery store to grab a snack and the entire aisle is empty.
You try to video chat with a friend and your internet connection keeps dropping every thirty seconds.
You hear the news that your favorite team played in a derby yesterday and missed the game entirely.
You rush to get to work early and find that the ferry is the only way to cross and it is currently closed.
You open your wallet at a restaurant and realize the cashier only has bills higher than the total is owed.
You find out your car will not start in the morning due to a broken battery.
You go to the store for a gift and find that the costume shop’s window is covered in ice from a heater blowout.
Your flight to the coast is delayed and the crowd at the gate is getting long.
You attempt to cook a new recipe and the kitchen faucet is not shut off so that all the pots overflow.
You plan to hire an artist for an event and find out they need to reschedule in two days.
You go to an online clinic to see about an appointment and find out the wait time is four hours.
You try to set a lamp but the bulb socket is broken.
You attempt to attach holiday ornaments to the tree but realize you bought nothing else this year.
You purchase insurance for your phone and find out that you have one month of protection left only to discover you dropped it the day you bought it.
You wake up with a slight fever and sweat through your sheets within thirty minutes.
You go to the library to return a book and find the return bins are full with the shelves nearly empty.
You try to window-sit in a window seat on the airplane but find out that the window is clearly broken with just a frame.
You arrive at the gym and find out that your weekly membership expires today and you are told it will cost you double to renew.
You try to light a candle and its wick is clearly already burnt off nearly an inch before you even get to it.
You try to order a coffee in your second language while frantically trying to pick up a different item from the basket.
You go to see a movie and find out that it was showing only on one screen and that screen is being taken out for a week.
You reach the end of your elevator ride only to realize that you forgot your keys and now you cannot access the lobby.
You try to take a picture of a sunset and the time for the ray already went past just as you tapped the screen.
You attempt to make a reservation at a restaurant that you hold dear and find out that it is fully booked for the next month.
You find yourself stuck in traffic and the traffic light turns off so that you must wait for the police car.
You arrive at a meeting and find out that the room has been repainted with a paint color that is not in line with the company’s official palette.
You go to the store to buy batteries and find out that the shelf is empty in the store but the price is low elsewhere.
You try to take a photo of the stars but it is cloudy and you see just the city lights.
You arrive at the beauty salon and find out that the stylist who created your hairpiece was sick today and the next available one will take hours.
You try to sign a piece of paper for your email receipt but the printer jams with a piece of paper stuck for the moment.
You try to order a meal from the takeout place and find out that the delivery guy is stuck in a breakdown.
You arrive at the mall and discover that the store you were hoping to shop in has already closed for the night.
You are on a roller coaster ride and your friend screams because you forgot to fasten your seatbelt.
You try to use your phone to take a selfie in the mirror but you see that the reflection is covered in raindrops.
You try to organize a bookshelf but the one that is in the middle is missing a few books that the friend never brought back.
You go for a run and suddenly realize that your shoelace is tied in a loop.
You try to order a pizza and find out one ingredient is out of stock so your friend has to pick a different one.
You see a street performer and realize only a couple of coins are left in his tip jar for the day.
You go to watch a sunset in the park but a sudden shower makes the area dark and you do not see the sun.
You find a wallet while out walking and find that the credit cards inside are expired and that the cash is minimal.
You buy a shirt and discover it is the wrong color the moment you walk away from the counter.
You try to catch a train and the station car is slightly full so no one can be seated on the train.
You arrive at the airport and realize you cannot enter without your passport which is in your other bag.
You attempt to park your car near the entrance but the ticket booth is broken and you cannot get your receipt.
